svg.title: Tarang
svg.desc: Tarang: a music-first web app. A spinning vermilion record, layered flowing waveforms, a rhythmic multicoloured equalizer, a smooth playback-progress trace, time-synced lyric lines that highlight in turn, and a floating mini player labelled as seed data. Frontend only.
svg.text: MUSIC-FIRST WEB APP · PERSISTENT PLAYER · DOCUMENTED DESIGN SYSTEM
DEMO AUDIO · SEED DATA · FRONTEND ONLY
Stylised audio scene. Seed data, no real catalogue, no album artwork.
